data.review_body: A terrible experience—they are thieves and scammers. You should only buy from them using PayPal; with any other payment method, you risk losing your money. These people are pathological liars who will deceive you. If you contact customer support, the representatives don't speak English at all; they just use copy-paste responses. After you pay for an item, they don't ship it. Don't be fooled into thinking they have a local warehouse—none of that exists; everything is shipped from China, even though they don't show you the actual transit process. I believe they should be banned from the United States, just as happened in Europe; they sell a lot of dangerous products and even spy on you. Under no circumstances should you install their app on your phone—just be very careful with them.Their representatives just apologize and claim to understand your problem—but they don't understand a damn thing. They don't grasp what you're writing at all; they just run your text through a translator and send you canned responses. Still, they do a great job of apologizing and insisting that they understand everything.Just look at how much junk is left behind when you leave their site—up to 500 MB; you definitely need to clean it out after using it.What they show is one thing, but what arrives is something else entirely: the photo depicts several items, yet they sell only one—it’s a complete scam, and there’s no description either. And it’s impossible to talk to the support staff—they don’t know English at all; I’ve already mentioned this.Don't trust the reviews left on their site; they're full of bots. Even the negative ones are posted by bots—just to make it look like there are negative reviews too.

data.review_body:
I filed a complaint and ticket with Temu over a month ago after fraud was committed by Temu themselves.  After more than a month, the issue is still not resolved.  What legitimate company does not deal with a complaint after a full month. Instead they just send and respond to emails saying someone will deal with it soon.  It is clear they have no intention of doing so.

Temu gets 0 Stars, but unfortunately that is not an option available. They committed fraud & bait & switch.

Two major issues. First, Temu processed an order I did NOT make. I had put some items in my cart, but I didn't process the order.  When later I saw an email saying payment had been taken and an order had been initiated, I contacted them to inform them I did NOT make the order and to cancel the order.  They refused, despite the fact that alleged 'order' had just been made and obviously it hadn't been processed and it certainly hadn't been shipped.  Surprise, Surprise.  Obviously they didn't want to refund the order, because the order had been fraudulently taken in the first place.  It was within the 14 days on an online 'purchase' (so I had a right to cancel), I didn't make the order in the first place (so they should have refunded a payment they were not allowed to take) and it hadn't been processed or shipped (so they should have refunded my money immediately). Instead they sent an order I didn't want.  

Second, they promised me SIX FREE GIFTS, but then didn't give the gifts and later said I didn't get the gifts because I need to spend a certain amount of money to get the gifts.  It didn't say that when the gifts were being offered and I spent about 1.5 hours choosing my gifts. This is called "Bait and Switch" which is highly illegal.  However, later the gifts were not offered to me or sent to me. I have been in several conversations with customer service since and they refuse to help me.  They just keep going round and round in circles.  

To start with, they sent the items I didn't order.  Then they refuse to refund the order and also refuse to send the 6 free gifts.  I made a formal complaint and they promised a manager would contact me in a few hours.  Instead it has been more than a month and they keep delaying further days. They have wasted so much of my time and caused so much stress. 

I reminded them of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 (CPRs). ​This law contains a "Blacklist" of 31 commercial practices that are banned in all circumstances, regardless of what the fine print says.

​Banned Practice #20: It is completely illegal to describe a product as "gratis", "free", "without charge", or similar if the consumer has to pay anything other than the unavoidable cost of responding to the advertisement or collecting/paying for delivery of the item.

​Banned Practice #6 ("Bait-and-Switch"): It is illegal to promote a specific product at a specific price (or for free) if the business actually intends to substitute it with a different requirement or force you into a different commercial transaction (like buying other goods to "unlock" it).  

Despite this reminder they remained unphased.

I am warning you, never give Temu your payment details or name or contact details.  They are a dodgy company and do not have an issue with committing fraud.  Who knows what else they are doing with your details. Never fall for their free gifts trick.  It is a scam.

Steer far clear from Temu!!!
data.review_headline: Temu Fraud & One month later, complaint not resolved.
